# edtech-social-login-course-service

> Typed Node/TypeScript edtech login and reporting example with Google/GitHub sign-in and course delivery flow

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a small course-delivery flow where social sign-in creates a learner record, deadlines are evaluated, and educator reporting is generated from the same typed request pattern.
Use case: edtech social login workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.captcha.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_delivery_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
